decision: Ready for a separately authorized preparation owner after the canonical guard is published and the migration decision is recorded. No preparation or capture was performed.
scope: Read-only source and CLI-help review. This packet is the only created artifact.

source_compatibility.supported: The executing runner is selected by Path(__file__). The explicit --repo supplies the harness patch, helper, extensions, cohort registries, capture review documents and Git baseline objects. Keeping --repo at exact482 while executing the reviewed guard runner is supported by these separate input paths.
source_compatibility.new_root_required: Plans use a fixed immutable filename, and source/live-source/CARGO_TARGET_DIR paths are root-bound. Official prepare and prepare-live must construct a new root. Do not alias old sources or targets, copy manifests, reuse old authentication keys, or import receipts.
source_compatibility.compiled_driver: The test-driver source and inventory must match482. A new-location test executable is independently built and inventoried; its bytes are not asserted identical without measurement.

environment.recipe: Use the controlled preparation environment and exact selected tools. Record fresh observations rather than copying old fingerprints. Only the new root-bound target path is an intended environment difference.
environment.tools: Python3.15.0; Cargo/Rust1.99.1; LLVM23.1.1; nextest0.9.148. Verify actual paths, binary hashes and compiler/linker observations against the old controlled recipe.
environment.terminal: Do not supply --term-profile. Retain harness-default profile with inherited runner TERM=xterm-ghostty and child TERM=xterm-256color, subject to exact environment verification.

clocks.original_cases: use only the clock policy declared by the pinned frozen scenario harness

stages.supervision: A separately reviewed external process supervisor must bound total execution plus cleanup to220seconds. Official timeout200seconds is not itself an inclusive process deadline. Use exclusive per-stage logs.

completed_run_guard.behavior: If authenticated completed_steps is >= len(planned), advance raises RunnerError("fresh run has no remaining planned chunks; finalization is not implemented") before accessing the expected-step guard. It never returns complete success. With visual phases completed but ordinary steps remaining, it raises RunnerError("ordinary-check advancement is not implemented; no phase was skipped") before checking explicit expected values.
completed_run_guard.stale_expectation: A stale explicit expectation is rejected, although terminal states use the existing terminal-state error rather than the expected-step-mismatch diagnostic. No attempt directory or application launch occurs.
completed_run_guard.reachability: The current journal validator rejects ordinary-check receipts, so an authenticated fully completed all-phase journal is not a normal producible state. The visual-complete/ordinary-pending state is relevant and remains an intentional incomplete gate.
completed_run_guard.review_method: Source inspection only; no actual key, run verification or journal mutation.

preservation.old_run_credit: Nine receipts and288checkpoints stay associated with their original plan/run. No automatic credit transfer to the new plan.
preservation.new_expected: No captured expected frames or chunks are copied into the new run. Frozen tag snapshots remain extraction inputs only.
preservation.custody: Only canonical official runner commands may access actual key bytes. This review did not open any key.

risks: Cold Nextest inventory may exceed the command budget. Preserve incomplete preparation and exclusive logs; do not bless incomplete inventory, edit manifests, remove cases or silently reset the root. Any recovery procedure requires review.
Do not reuse the old exact-environment wrapper: it assigns m.run and opens output logs with overwrite mode. Invoke the canonical CLI under external supervision without monkeypatching.
Preserve full source, binary, prefix and expected-data hashes. No caching or validation weakening is proposed.
Reserve a quiet resource window for preparation/verification. Timeout is failure, not partial credit.
The final advance argv is documentation only. Capture still requires independent plan/run/supervisor approval.
Product acceptance, checkpoint reference approval, candidate comparison and ordinary-check completion remain false/incomplete.
